about: The epistola of the formulary “Second Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Dearly beloved: Christ suffered for us, leaving you an example that you should follow His steps. He did no sin, neither was guile found in His mouth. When He was reviled, He reviled not; when He suffered, He threatened not, but delivered Himself to him that judged Him unjustly. He Himself bore our sins in His body upon the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto justice; by Whose wounds you were healed. For you were as sheep going astray, but you are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
g: trick, device, deceit, treachery, trickery, cunning, fraud
